title: Spacecraft momentum anomalies in the Van Allen belts

tellings.quote:
like momentum anomalies for spacecraft
when they go around the earth
>> and they get to the Van Allen belts.
They either speed up or they slow down

plain: Spacecraft circling the Earth either speed up or slow down unexpectedly when they reach the Van Allen belts, the zones of charged particles that surround the planet. Charles Buhler, who worked at NASA, mentions these momentum anomalies to Michels without naming a source. He brings them up as a clue that something about how motion works there is not yet understood.
